High-level shape: auth service = Pages Functions on tspsolver.com (same origin,
`rpID = tspsolver.com`), storage = Cloudflare D1 (users / credentials / api_keys /
challenges), sessions = signed cookie (30 d sliding), keys = `ak_` + SHA-256 at rest shown
once, `teeline-api` (Fly.io) keeps its `ApiKeyVerifier` contract and calls
`POST /api/auth/keys/verify` via a new `ServiceVerifier`; break-glass `API_KEY` behind a
`TEELINE_AUTH_MODE` toggle (`breakglass` for local-dev & CI, `service` for prod). Hard cut
from Clerk (no users; Clerk never exposes raw keys anyway).
